name: abcoda
description: Interactive ABC music scores for AI conversations, built with MCP Apps.

scripts.build: npm run build:widget && npm run build:server
scripts.build:v2-worker: npm run build:v2-widget && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config apps/worker/wrangler.jsonc --outdir ../../dist/v2-worker
scripts.build:worker: npm run build:widget && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/worker
scripts.dev: npm run build:widget && tsx watch server/index.ts
scripts.lint: eslint packages apps tests/v2 tests/worker tests/browser playwright.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck:v2
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:v2-widget && npm run test:v2-worker && npm run build && npm run build:v2-worker && npm run verify:v2-artifacts && npm run build:worker
scripts.check:browser: npm run check && npm run test:browser
